```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(scales)

landwirtschaft_2020 <- read_csv2(
  "../data/landwirtschaft/landwirtschaft_tierhaltung_2020.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

format_ganz <- function(x) {
  format(
    round(x, 0),
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    scientific = FALSE,
    trim = TRUE
  )
}

format_dezimal <- function(x) {
  format(
    round(x, 1),
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    nsmall = 1,
    scientific = FALSE,
    trim = TRUE
  )
}
```


# 🌾 Agriculture

## Livestock per capita (2020)

How many cattle, pigs and chickens are kept in the municipalities of Grafschaft Bentheim relative to their population?

The following visualisations compare the **25 municipalities of Grafschaft Bentheim** based on the number of animals per inhabitant in 2020.

Only the total stocks of the following three animal species are considered:

- 🐄 **Cattle**
- 🐖 **Pigs**
- 🐔 **Chickens**

The absolute livestock numbers are taken from the Agricultural Structure Survey of the Lower Saxony State Office for Statistics. For municipality-level figures that were not published, **“n/a”** is shown.

> **Note:** Livestock numbers refer to 1 March 2020. Population figures are also for the year 2020.


---

## 🫧 Bubble board

Each bubble represents a municipality. The **X-axis** shows the population in 2020, while the **Y-axis** shows the number of animals per inhabitant. The **bubble size** corresponds to the absolute number of animals.

Use the selector to switch between 🐄 cattle, 🐖 pigs and 🐔 chickens.

::: {.landwirtschaft-chart}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Daten für Bubble-Board vorbereiten
# Grafschaft insgesamt bewusst ausschließen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bubble_rinder <- landwirtschaft_2020 |>
  filter(
    gemeinde != "Grafschaft insgesamt",
    !is.na(rinder_2020)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    gemeinde,
    einwohner_2020,
    tierzahl = rinder_2020,
    tiere_je_einwohner = rinder_je_einwohner
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bubble_size = rescale(
      sqrt(tierzahl),
      to = c(14, 58)
    ),
    hover = paste0(
      "<b>🐄 ", gemeinde, "</b>",
      "<br>Population 2020: ", format_ganz(einwohner_2020),
      "<br>Cattle 2020: ", format_ganz(tierzahl),
      "<br><b>Cattle per inhabitant: ",
      format_dezimal(tiere_je_einwohner),
      "</b>"
    )
  )


bubble_schweine <- landwirtschaft_2020 |>
  filter(
    gemeinde != "Grafschaft insgesamt",
    !is.na(schweine_2020)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    gemeinde,
    einwohner_2020,
    tierzahl = schweine_2020,
    tiere_je_einwohner = schweine_je_einwohner
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bubble_size = rescale(
      sqrt(tierzahl),
      to = c(14, 58)
    ),
    hover = paste0(
      "<b>🐖 ", gemeinde, "</b>",
      "<br>Population 2020: ", format_ganz(einwohner_2020),
      "<br>Pigs 2020: ", format_ganz(tierzahl),
      "<br><b>Pigs per inhabitant: ",
      format_dezimal(tiere_je_einwohner),
      "</b>"
    )
  )


bubble_huehner <- landwirtschaft_2020 |>
  filter(
    gemeinde != "Grafschaft insgesamt",
    !is.na(huehner_2020)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    gemeinde,
    einwohner_2020,
    tierzahl = huehner_2020,
    tiere_je_einwohner = huehner_je_einwohner
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bubble_size = rescale(
      sqrt(tierzahl),
      to = c(14, 58)
    ),
    hover = paste0(
      "<b>🐔 ", gemeinde, "</b>",

      "<br>Chickens 2020: ", format_ganz(tierzahl),
      "<br><b>Chickens per inhabitant: ",
      format_dezimal(tiere_je_einwohner),
      "</b>"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bubble-Grafik
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bubble <- plot_ly() |>

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Smartphone:
# natives Auswahlfeld + kompaktere Achse + kleinere Bubbles
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bubble <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_bubble,
  "
  function(el, x) {

    var menu =
      x.layout &&
      x.layout.updatemenus &&
      x.layout.updatemenus.length
        ? x.layout.updatemenus[0]
        : null;

    var buttons =
      menu && menu.buttons
        ? menu.buttons
        : [];


    var originalSizes =
      x.data.map(
        function(trace) {

          if (
            trace.marker &&
            Array.isArray(trace.marker.size)
          ) {
            return trace.marker.size.slice();
          }

          if (trace.marker) {
            return trace.marker.size;
          }

          return null;
        }
      );


    var originalHeight =
      x.layout.height ||
      el.clientHeight ||
      500;


    var wrapper =
      document.createElement('div');

    wrapper.className =
      'mobile-plotly-select-wrap';


    var label =
      document.createElement('label');

    label.className =
      'mobile-plotly-select-label';

    label.textContent =
      'Select animal species';


    var select =
      document.createElement('select');

    select.className =
      'mobile-plotly-select';

    select.setAttribute(
      'aria-label',
      'Select animal species'
    );


    buttons.forEach(
      function(button, index) {

        var option =
          document.createElement('option');

        option.value =
          String(index);

        option.textContent =
          button.label;

        if (index === 0) {
          option.selected = true;
        }

        select.appendChild(option);
      }
    );


    wrapper.appendChild(label);
    wrapper.appendChild(select);


    if (el.parentNode) {

      el.parentNode.insertBefore(
        wrapper,
        el
      );
    }


    function setBubbleSizes(mobile) {

      originalSizes.forEach(
        function(sizes, index) {

          if (sizes === null) {
            return;
          }

          var newSizes;

          if (Array.isArray(sizes)) {

            newSizes =
              sizes.map(
                function(size) {

                  return mobile
                    ? size * 0.82
                    : size;

                }
              );

          } else {

            newSizes =
              mobile
                ? sizes * 0.82
                : sizes;
          }


          Plotly.restyle(
            el,
            {
              'marker.size': [newSizes]
            },
            [index]
          );
        }
      );
    }


    function responsiveBubble() {

      var mobile =
        window.innerWidth <= 600;


      wrapper.style.display =
        mobile ? 'block' : 'none';


      setBubbleSizes(mobile);


      var update = {

        'autosize': true,

        'height':
          mobile
            ? 520
            : originalHeight,

        'margin.l':
          mobile ? 58 : 75,

        'margin.r':
          mobile ? 8 : 25,

        'margin.t':
          mobile ? 20 : 95,

        'margin.b':
          mobile ? 78 : 70,


        'xaxis.title.font.size':
          mobile ? 11 : 14,

        'xaxis.tickfont.size':
          mobile ? 9 : 12,

        'xaxis.tickangle':
          mobile ? -35 : 0,


        'xaxis.tickvals':
          mobile
            ? [500, 2000, 10000, 50000]
            : [
                500,
                1000,
                2000,
                5000,
                10000,
                20000,
                50000
              ],


        'xaxis.ticktext':
          mobile
            ? [
                '500',
                '2,000',
                '10,000',
                '50,000'
              ]
            : [
                '500',
                '1,000',
                '2,000',
                '5,000',
                '10,000',
                '20,000',
                '50,000'
              ],


        'yaxis.title.font.size':
          mobile ? 11 : 14,

        'yaxis.tickfont.size':
          mobile ? 9 : 12,


        'hoverlabel.font.size':
          mobile ? 11 : 13,


        'updatemenus[0].visible':
          !mobile
      };


      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        update
      );


      Plotly.Plots.resize(el);
    }


    select.addEventListener(
      'change',
      function() {

        var index =
          Number(select.value);

        var button =
          buttons[index];


        if (
          !button ||
          !button.args
        ) {
          return;
        }


        Plotly.update(
          el,
          button.args[0] || {},
          button.args[1] || {}
        ).then(
          function() {

            responsiveBubble();

          }
        );
      }
    );


    responsiveBubble();


    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      responsiveBubble
    );
  }
  "
)


p_bubble
```

:::

*The chicken view includes only municipalities for which the LSN published a livestock figure. Unpublished values are not interpreted as zero.*

**Source:** Lower Saxony State Office for Statistics (LSN), Agricultural Structure Survey 2020; population as of 2020.

## 🏆 Ranking: animals per inhabitant

Which municipalities have the highest livestock numbers relative to their population?

The bars show the respective number of **animals per inhabitant in 2020**. Grafschaft Bentheim as a whole is shown separately below the municipalities as a reference value.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Funktion: Ranking-Karte erzeugen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ranking_karte <- function(
    daten,
    wert_spalte,
    tierzahl_spalte,
    tiername,
    emoji,
    css_klasse
) {

  gemeinden <- daten |>

    filter(
      gemeinde != "Grafschaft insgesamt"
    ) |>

    mutate(
      wert = .data[[wert_spalte]],
      tierzahl = .data[[tierzahl_spalte]]
    ) |>

    arrange(
      desc(wert),
      gemeinde
    ) |>

    mutate(
      rang =
        ifelse(
          is.na(wert),
          NA_integer_,
          cumsum(!is.na(wert))
        )
    )


  landkreis <- daten |>

    filter(
      gemeinde == "Grafschaft insgesamt"
    ) |>

    mutate(
      wert = .data[[wert_spalte]],
      tierzahl = .data[[tierzahl_spalte]]
    )


  max_wert <- max(
    gemeinden$wert,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  ranking_zeile <- function(
      gemeinde,
      wert,
      tierzahl,
      einwohner,
      rang = NA,
      landkreis = FALSE
  ) {

    fehlt <- is.na(wert)


    rang_text <-
      if (landkreis) {

        "D"

      } else if (fehlt) {

        "–"

      } else {

        as.character(rang)
      }


    wert_text <-
      if (fehlt) {

        "n/a"

      } else {

        format_dezimal(wert)
      }


    breite <-
      if (fehlt) {

        0

      } else {

        max(
          2,
          min(
            100,
            wert / max_wert * 100
          )
        )
      }


    tooltip <-
      if (fehlt) {

        paste0(
          gemeinde,
          ": livestock figure for 2020 not published"
        )

      } else {

        paste0(
          gemeinde,
          " | Population: ",
          format_ganz(einwohner),
          " | ",
          tiername,
          ": ",
          format_ganz(tierzahl),
          " | ",
          tiername,
          " per inhabitant: ",
          format_dezimal(wert)
        )
      }


    gemeinde_anzeige <-
      ifelse(
        gemeinde == "Grafschaft insgesamt",
        "Grafschaft Bentheim (total)",
        gemeinde
      )


    gemeinde_html <-
      htmltools::htmlEscape(gemeinde_anzeige)


    tooltip_html <-
      htmltools::htmlEscape(tooltip)


    klasse <-
      if (fehlt) {

        "agrar-ranking-row agrar-ranking-missing"

      } else {

        "agrar-ranking-row"
      }


    paste0(

      '<div class="',
      klasse,
      '" title="',
      tooltip_html,
      '" onclick="this.classList.toggle(\'is-open\')" tabindex="0">',

      '<div class="agrar-ranking-rang">',
      rang_text,
      '</div>',

      '<div class="agrar-ranking-gemeinde">',
      gemeinde_html,
      '</div>',

      '<div class="agrar-ranking-track">',

      if (!fehlt) {
        paste0(
          '<div class="agrar-ranking-bar" style="width:',
          sprintf("%.1f", breite),
          '%;"></div>'
        )
      } else {
        '<div class="agrar-ranking-bar agrar-ranking-bar-missing" style="width:100%;"></div>'
      },

      '</div>',

      '<div class="agrar-ranking-value">',
      wert_text,
      '</div>',

      '<div class="agrar-ranking-mobile-detail">',
      if (fehlt) {

        paste0(
          tiername,
          ": livestock figure for 2020 not published."
        )

      } else {

        paste0(
          "Population: ",
          format_ganz(einwohner),
          " · ",
          tiername,
          ": ",
          format_ganz(tierzahl),
          " · ",
          tiername,
          " per inhabitant: ",
          format_dezimal(wert)
        )

      },
      '</div>',

      '</div>'
    )
  }


  zeilen <- vapply(

    seq_len(nrow(gemeinden)),

    function(i) {

      ranking_zeile(

        gemeinde =
          gemeinden$gemeinde[i],

        wert =
          gemeinden$wert[i],

        tierzahl =
          gemeinden$tierzahl[i],

        einwohner =
          gemeinden$einwohner_2020[i],

        rang =
          gemeinden$rang[i],

        landkreis =
          FALSE
      )
    },

    character(1)
  )


  landkreis_zeile <- ranking_zeile(

    gemeinde =
      "Grafschaft insgesamt",

    wert =
      landkreis$wert[1],

    tierzahl =
      landkreis$tierzahl[1],

    einwohner =
      landkreis$einwohner_2020[1],

    rang =
      NA,

    landkreis =
      TRUE
  )


  paste0(

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-card ',
    css_klasse,
    '">',

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-header">',

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-header-emoji">',
    emoji,
    '</div>',

    '<div>',

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-header-title">',
    tiername,
    '</div>',

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-header-subtitle">',
    tiername,
    ' per inhabitant (2020)',
    '</div>',

    '</div>',

    '</div>',

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-list">',

    paste(
      zeilen,
      collapse = ""
    ),

    '</div>',

    '<div class="agrar-ranking-landkreis">',

    landkreis_zeile,

    '</div>',

    '</div>'
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Drei Rankings erstellen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ranking_rinder <- ranking_karte(

  daten =
    landwirtschaft_2020,

  wert_spalte =
    "rinder_je_einwohner",

)


ranking_schweine <- ranking_karte(

ranking_huehner <- ranking_karte(

```

::: {.agrar-ranking-hinweis}

**D = Grafschaft Bentheim as a whole.** The district is shown separately below the 25 municipalities as a reference value and therefore does not receive a rank.

Where **“n/a”** is shown, the livestock figure was not published by the LSN. These municipalities are excluded from the ranking of available values and are explicitly **not treated as zero**.

**Source:** Lower Saxony State Office for Statistics (LSN), Agricultural Structure Survey 2020; population as of 2020.

:::
